posts.title: My first two months with AI agents: some confident assertions
posts.description: About two months ago, I started using modern AI tools in my research in a serious way. It’s been a tremendously exciting and also unsettling experience. To give you an idea how fast this happened, my in-laws arrived from Korea in early September to visit us for three weeks, right about the same time all this started for me.
